top_signals.title: Trump Heads to Asia With Trade, Security at Stake
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg’s Avril Hong is on Bloomberg This Weekend to preview President Donald Trump’s trip to Asia, where trade, security ties and China’s growing regional influence are expected to shape meetings with Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. and other Southeast Asian leaders. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Hong also examines the business stakes surrounding the trip, including Elon Musk’s reported participation and the debate over US restrictions on China’s access to advanced semiconductor technology. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: 'We slept here.' Flight delays linger as airlines scramble to recover from ground stop
top_signals.summary: Flight disruptions lingered two days after the Federal Aviation Administration grounded departures nationwide for more than four hours.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
